description: This Java source file defines the UserDictionaryPrefsProvider class, which implements the PrefsProvider interface. It manages the loading and storing of user dictionary preferences, including reading and writing words and their frequencies for different locales, using reactive programming with RxJava.

classes.name: UserDictionaryPrefsProvider
classes.description: A class that provides user dictionary preferences, allowing loading and storing of words and frequencies for different locales.

methods.name: UserDictionaryPrefsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a context and retrieves locales from dictionary add-ons.

methods.name: providerId
methods.description: Returns the identifier string for this provider.

methods.name: getPrefsRoot
methods.description: Builds and returns the preferences root containing locale-specific dictionaries.

methods.name: storePrefsRoot
methods.description: Stores the preferences root data into the user dictionaries, adding words and handling errors.
